items.name: anchor_pi
items.rule: the host's built-in --values pi (0x40490FDB): the tie to E60-E79's anchor_pi

items.name: fp16.a_zeros_b_complement
items.rule: A every word zero (every micro-op gated); B columns 0-7 random fp16 halves (sign random, exponent field U{1..30}, random mantissa), column l+8 their 16-bit complements: every lane's B flips all 32 bits every cycle behind the gate
items.open_case: Z zeros' transport: B traffic under gated and live zero A operands (item 13)

items.name: fp16.anchor6_randn
items.rule: standard normal both sides, a fresh draw (footing: as fp16.randn)
items.open_case: 0 anchor (footing)

items.name: fp16.anchor6_zeros
items.rule: every element +0.0 (footing: as fp16.zeros)
items.open_case: 0 anchor (footing)

items.name: fp16.b_onebit_b6_third
items.rule: A every element 1.0 (0x3C00); B every half 1/3 (0x3555) with bit 6 of each half flipped in columns 8-15: each lane flips two bits (one per half) every cycle, on a base word no fp16 single-bit run has used
items.open_case: S single bits on other base words (item 15)

items.name: fp16.c_absorbed
items.rule: standard normal both sides (fp16) except A's columns 0-1 and B's lines 0-1, every element 2^15: each op first adds 2^31 to every C element, which then absorbs the other fifteen two-term sums (ulp 2^8 and up)
items.open_case: C the C-register candidate: operands as busy as random data, an accumulator that barely moves

items.name: fp16.e5m2grid_wide
items.rule: fp8 e5m2 values held in fp16 (the low 8 mantissa bits zero, round to nearest even), from randn * 2^U{-6..6}, both sides: 2 mantissa bits against 5 exponent bits
items.open_case: E exponent-heavy: operand flips concentrated in the exponent field (E147: the card pays 0.82-0.84 of the models' watts on exponent flips)

items.name: fp16.exp_a_walk_fixedmant
items.rule: A halves (1 + m) * 2^(e-15), positive, one random mantissa per (word column, half) and exponent field U{5..25} per element: A's walk flips exponent bits only; B random normal with columns l and l+8 equal (the lanes never alternate)
items.open_case: E exponent-heavy: operand flips concentrated in the exponent field (E147: the card pays 0.82-0.84 of the models' watts on exponent flips)

items.name: fp16.exp_b_alt_shift
items.rule: A every element 1.5 (0x3E00); B columns 0-7 random sign, random mantissa, exponent field U{8..22}; column l+8 the same halves with the exponent field moved by d in +-1..6 (per half): each lane's alternation flips exponent bits only
items.open_case: E exponent-heavy: operand flips concentrated in the exponent field (E147: the card pays 0.82-0.84 of the models' watts on exponent flips)

items.name: fp16.exp_only
items.rule: fp16 random sign * 2^(e-15), exponent field e uniform 1..30, mantissa 0, both sides: only sign and exponent bits move, every product a power of two
items.open_case: 3 exponent-only activity (E140 miss)

items.name: fp16.exp_only_narrow2
items.rule: fp16 random sign * 2^(e-15), exponent field e in 13..17 (1/4..4), mantissa 0, both sides: steps across 1.0/2.0 (01111/10000) flip all five exponent bits; every product a power of two
items.open_case: E exponent-heavy: operand flips concentrated in the exponent field (E147: the card pays 0.82-0.84 of the models' watts on exponent flips)

items.name: fp16.randn
items.rule: standard normal, sigma 1, rounded to fp16

items.name: fp16.real_qwen_dequant_v
items.rule: Qwen2.5-0.5B layer 0: A = input_layernorm output (tokens 16-31, dims 0-31) in fp16; B = v_proj weights dequantised (int8 x channel scale) rows 0-15 x dims 0-31, transposed, in fp16 (a W8A16 matmul)
items.open_case: R real model tiles: W8A8 projections and attention matmuls from two public W8A8 checkpoints (item 7; critic rank 8)

items.name: fp16.real_qwen_qk
items.rule: Qwen2.5-0.5B (W8A8 checkpoint) layer 0, head 3: A = rotary queries with q_proj's bias (tokens 16-31, dims 0-31), B = rotary keys with k_proj's bias (KV head 0, tokens 0-15), transposed (keys up to 121.6)
items.open_case: R real model tiles: W8A8 projections and attention matmuls from two public W8A8 checkpoints (item 7; critic rank 8)

items.name: fp16.real_smol_qk
items.rule: SmolLM-135M (W8A8 checkpoint) layer 0, head 1: A = rotary queries (tokens 16-31, head dims 0-31), B = rotary keys of KV head 0, tokens 0-15, transposed: the attention scores' matmul; fp32 values rounded to fp16
items.open_case: R real model tiles: W8A8 projections and attention matmuls from two public W8A8 checkpoints (item 7; critic rank 8)

items.name: fp16.real_smol_softmax_v
items.rule: SmolLM-135M layer 0, head 1: A = causal softmax (query tokens 16-31 x key tokens 0-31: exact zeros above the diagonal, 120 of 512 elements); B = values (keys 0-31, head dims 0-15); the one B value that rounds to an fp16 subnormal is written as +0.0, so C does not depend on whether the unit flushes subnormals before PRM 9.4's nonzero test
items.open_case: R real model tiles: W8A8 projections and attention matmuls from two public W8A8 checkpoints (item 7; critic rank 8)

items.name: fp16.sparse24_aligned
items.rule: randn; B 2:4 along k with the two zeros of every group of four k in ONE word (k 4m,4m+1 or 4m+2,4m+3, at random per group and column): half of B's words zero, so half the lane-slots gate
items.open_case: 9 structured stream

items.name: fp16.zeros
items.rule: every element +0.0 (0x0000): every lane gated

items.name: fp32.a_onebit_b16_half
items.rule: A every word 0.5 (0x3F000000, zero mantissa) with bit 16 set in the odd rows: one A bit walks on a base word with no other mantissa bit; B every element 1.0
items.open_case: S single bits on other base words (item 15)

items.name: fp32.a_onebit_b5_third
items.rule: A every word 1/3 (0x3EAAAAAB) with bit 5 set in the odd rows: each step down an A column flips that one bit (the recoded operand, a new base word); B every element 1.0
items.open_case: S single bits on other base words (item 15)

items.name: fp32.a_zeros_b_complement
items.rule: A every element +0.0 (every micro-op gated); B columns 0-7 random words (sign random, exponent field U{64..191}, random mantissa), column l+8 their bitwise complement: each lane's B flips all 32 bits every cycle, the most B traffic a tile can carry, all of it behind a closed gate
items.open_case: Z zeros' transport: B traffic under gated and live zero A operands (item 13)

items.name: fp32.anchor6_randn
items.rule: standard normal both sides, a fresh draw (footing: as fp32.randn)
items.open_case: 0 anchor (footing)

items.name: fp32.anchor6_zeros
items.rule: every element +0.0 (footing: the zero reference, as fp32.zeros)
items.open_case: 0 anchor (footing)

items.name: fp32.b_exp_busy_a_const
items.rule: A every element 1.25 (0x3FA00000, never changes); B random sign * 2^U{-40..40}, mantissa 0: exponent-only activity on the side that alternates every cycle (blind 4's version had it on A)
items.open_case: 3 exponent-only activity (E140 miss)

items.name: fp32.b_onebit_b12_third
items.rule: A every element 1.0; B every word 1/3 (0x3EAAAAAB) with bit 12 flipped in columns 8-15: each lane flips that one mantissa bit every cycle (4,096 flips an op), on a base word no single-bit run has used
items.open_case: S single bits on other base words (item 15)

items.name: fp32.b_onebit_b20_third
items.rule: as b_onebit_b12_third with bit 20 (a high mantissa bit) flipping on every lane every cycle
items.open_case: S single bits on other base words (item 15)

items.name: fp32.bf16_wideexp
items.rule: bf16 values with spread exponents, both sides: random sign, exponent 2^U{-40..40}, 7 random mantissa bits, the low 16 bits zero: about as many exponent flips as mantissa flips
items.open_case: E exponent-heavy: operand flips concentrated in the exponent field (E147: the card pays 0.82-0.84 of the models' watts on exponent flips)

items.name: fp32.c_absorbed
items.rule: standard normal both sides except A's column 0 and B's line 0, every element 2^50: each op first adds 2^100 to every C element, which then absorbs the other fifteen products (ulp 2^77): operands nearly as busy as randn, C changing once an op in its low bits
items.open_case: C the C-register candidate: operands as busy as random data, an accumulator that barely moves

items.name: fp32.exp_a_pow2wide_b_randn
items.rule: A random sign * 2^U{-30..30} (mantissa 0: only A's sign and exponent move); B standard normal (its mantissas busy): every product is one of B's mantissas, rescaled
items.open_case: E exponent-heavy: operand flips concentrated in the exponent field (E147: the card pays 0.82-0.84 of the models' watts on exponent flips)

items.name: fp32.exp_a_walk_fixedmant
items.rule: A[i][k] = (1 + m_k) * 2^e_ik, positive, one random mantissa per column k and exponent U{-20..20} per element: A's walk down each column flips exponent bits only; B random normal with columns l and l+8 equal, so the lanes never alternate and B changes only at the 16 line boundaries
items.open_case: E exponent-heavy: operand flips concentrated in the exponent field (E147: the card pays 0.82-0.84 of the models' watts on exponent flips)

items.name: fp32.exp_b_alt_shift
items.rule: A every element 1.5 (never changes); B columns 0-7 random sign, random mantissa, exponent 2^U{-8..8}; column l+8 is column l times 2^d (d in +-1..12, per word): each lane's every-cycle alternation flips exponent bits only
items.open_case: E exponent-heavy: operand flips concentrated in the exponent field (E147: the card pays 0.82-0.84 of the models' watts on exponent flips)

items.name: fp32.exp_only_narrow2
items.rule: both sides random sign * 2^U{-2..2}, mantissa field 0: values within 1/4..4, but the exponent field runs 125..129, so every step across 1.0/2.0 (0x7F/0x80) flips all eight exponent bits; products are exact powers of two
items.open_case: E exponent-heavy: operand flips concentrated in the exponent field (E147: the card pays 0.82-0.84 of the models' watts on exponent flips)

items.name: fp32.negzero_a_b_complement
items.rule: A every element -0.0 (0x80000000: a nonzero word, so no lane gates, yet every product is a zero); B as a_zeros_b_complement's rule (fresh draw): the same B traffic in live lanes that multiply zeros
items.open_case: Z zeros' transport: B traffic under gated and live zero A operands (item 13)

items.name: fp32.randn
items.rule: standard normal, sigma 1

items.name: fp32.real_pythia_ln1_q
items.rule: pythia-70m layer 0 on Dickens' opening: A = input_layernorm output (tokens 16-31, dims 0-15, computed in fp32: full mantissas); B = query_key_value rows 576-591 (head 3's query) x input dims 0-15, transposed (fp16 values)
items.open_case: 5 real model (pythia-70m layer 0 forward)

items.name: fp32.real_qwen_dequant_q
items.rule: Qwen2.5-0.5B (W8A8 checkpoint) layer 0: A = input_layernorm output (tokens 16-31, dims 0-15, fp32); B = q_proj weights dequantised (int8 x its channel's bf16 scale, exact in fp32) rows 0-15 x dims 0-15, transposed (30 zero words)
items.open_case: R real model tiles: W8A8 projections and attention matmuls from two public W8A8 checkpoints (item 7; critic rank 8)

items.name: fp32.real_qwen_softmax_v
items.rule: Qwen2.5-0.5B layer 0, head 3: A = softmax of query tokens 16-31 x key tokens 0-15 (every key precedes: no masked zeros); B = values of key tokens 0-15, head dims 0-15
items.open_case: R real model tiles: W8A8 projections and attention matmuls from two public W8A8 checkpoints (item 7; critic rank 8)

items.name: fp32.real_smol_softmax_v_causal
items.rule: SmolLM-135M (W8A8 checkpoint) layer 0, head 1: A = causal softmax of query tokens 0-15 x key tokens 0-15 (the diagonal block: exact zeros above the diagonal, 120 of 256 words); B = values of key tokens 0-15, head dims 0-15
items.open_case: R real model tiles: W8A8 projections and attention matmuls from two public W8A8 checkpoints (item 7; critic rank 8)

items.name: fp32.signexp_invert_b
items.rule: A every element 1.25; B columns 0-7 random sign, exponent field U{87..167}, random mantissa; column l+8 is column l with its sign and all eight exponent bits inverted (XOR 0xFF800000): every lane flips exactly 9 bits a cycle, all in sign and exponent, the mantissa held
items.open_case: E exponent-heavy: operand flips concentrated in the exponent field (E147: the card pays 0.82-0.84 of the models' watts on exponent flips)

items.name: fp32.zeros
items.rule: every element +0.0 (0x00000000): every lane gated on an accumulate pass

items.name: int8.a_word_zero_one
items.rule: A rows alternate all 0x00 (even i, gated) and all 0x01 (+1, odd i): the A-side zero/one flip-flop, 4 bits a word changing every micro-op (blind 5's a_word_flipflop changed all 32); B uniform
items.open_case: L int8 whole-line or whole-word flip-flops (E141's steady int8 misses)

items.name: int8.a_zeros_b_lineflip
items.rule: A every byte 0x00 (every micro-op gated); B lines alternate all 0x7F and all 0x80: all 512 B bits flip at every line boundary behind the closed gate (int8's zeros' transport)
items.open_case: Z zeros' transport: B traffic under gated and live zero A operands (item 13)

items.name: int8.anchor6_full
items.rule: uniform -128..127 both sides, a fresh draw (footing: as int8.full, the lab's int8 random anchor)
items.open_case: 0 anchor (footing)

items.name: int8.anchor6_zeros
items.rule: every byte 0x00 (footing: as int8.zeros)
items.open_case: 0 anchor (footing)

items.name: int8.b_line_55_aa
items.rule: A uniform -128..127; B lines alternate all 0x55 (+85) and all 0xAA (-86): every boundary flips all 512 B bits, no byte zero (blind 5's b_line_flipflop_nogate flipped 0x7F/0x80, the same count on other values)
items.open_case: L int8 whole-line or whole-word flip-flops (E141's steady int8 misses)

items.name: int8.b_line_zero_ff
items.rule: A uniform -128..127; B lines alternate all 0x00 (even k-groups: every slot gated) and all 0xFF (-1): the gate of blind 5's b_line_zero_one with all 512 B bits flipping at each boundary instead of 64
items.open_case: L int8 whole-line or whole-word flip-flops (E141's steady int8 misses)

items.name: int8.b_line_zero_full
items.rule: A uniform -128..127; B lines alternate all 0x00 (even k-groups, gated) and uniform random bytes (odd)
items.open_case: L int8 whole-line or whole-word flip-flops (E141's steady int8 misses)

items.name: int8.b_line_zero_one
items.rule: A uniform -128..127; B lines alternate all 0x00 (even k-groups: every slot gated) and all 0x01 (+1): blind 4's b_line_flipflop gate exactly, with 64 of the 512 B bits flipping at each boundary instead of all 512
items.open_case: 6 whole-line / whole-word flip-flops (E140 miss)

items.name: int8.bflip_bit2_w
items.rule: E130's line-parity layout on a new base word: A every byte +1; B every word 0x4E3B6A19, with bit 2 of every byte flipped on the odd lines (1,024 B flips an op at one position)
items.open_case: B int8 B-position: B's bits held or flipped at one position (E138, E145)

items.name: int8.bflip_bit5_w
items.rule: as bflip_bit2_w with bit 5 of every byte flipping on the odd lines
items.open_case: B int8 B-position: B's bits held or flipped at one position (E138, E145)

items.name: int8.bheld_bit1
items.rule: A uniform -128..127; B every byte 0x02 (one bit set, at position 1, never changing): A's every-micro-op changes meet a B that holds one bit at one position
items.open_case: B int8 B-position: B's bits held or flipped at one position (E138, E145)

items.name: int8.bheld_bit4
items.rule: as bheld_bit1 with B every byte 0x10 (bit 4)
items.open_case: B int8 B-position: B's bits held or flipped at one position (E138, E145)

items.name: int8.bheld_bit7
items.rule: as bheld_bit1 with B every byte 0x80 (bit 7 alone: -128)
items.open_case: B int8 B-position: B's bits held or flipped at one position (E138, E145)

items.name: int8.full
items.rule: uniform over -128..127, the whole two's-complement range (E64's int8 `randn`)

items.name: int8.gray_a
items.rule: random bytes in a Gray-coded A stream: A word (i, p) = base_p XOR the 4-bit gray(i) spread one bit to each byte's LSB, so each micro-op (one step down a word-column) flips exactly one A bit; B uniform
items.open_case: 9 structured stream

items.name: int8.powerlaw_df15_pt
items.rule: heavier tails: B = W[0:64, 0:16] of a 1024x64 Student-t (df 1.5) tensor, symmetric per-tensor int8 (most bytes 0 or +-1); A = Laplace activations quantised per token
items.open_case: W seeded power-law weights, int8 (E141's steady int8 misses)

items.name: int8.powerlaw_df4_pc
items.rule: power-law weights with a per-channel scale: B = W[0:64, 0:16] of a 1024x16 Student-t (df 4) tensor, int8 per output channel (max abs over its 1024 inputs / 127); A = Laplace activations quantised per token
items.open_case: W seeded power-law weights, int8 (E141's steady int8 misses)

items.name: int8.real_qwen_w8a8_down
items.rule: Qwen2.5-0.5B W8A8 layer 0, down_proj: A = SiLU(gate) * up (tokens 16-31, hidden 0-63) quantised per token (max abs over all 4864 / 127: most bytes small); B = the checkpoint's int8 down_proj rows 0-15 x hidden 0-63, transposed
items.open_case: R real model tiles: W8A8 projections and attention matmuls from two public W8A8 checkpoints (item 7; critic rank 8)

items.name: int8.real_qwen_w8a8_gate
items.rule: Qwen2.5-0.5B W8A8 layer 0, gate_proj: A = post_attention_layernorm output after attention and the residual (tokens 16-31, dims 64-127) quantised per token; B = the checkpoint's int8 gate_proj rows 0-15 x dims 64-127, transposed
items.open_case: R real model tiles: W8A8 projections and attention matmuls from two public W8A8 checkpoints (item 7; critic rank 8)

items.name: int8.real_qwen_w8a8_v
items.rule: Qwen2.5-0.5B W8A8 layer 0, v_proj: A = input_layernorm output (tokens 16-31, dims 0-63) quantised per token (max abs over all 896 / 127); B = the checkpoint's int8 v_proj rows 0-15 x dims 0-63, transposed
items.open_case: R real model tiles: W8A8 projections and attention matmuls from two public W8A8 checkpoints (item 7; critic rank 8)

items.name: int8.real_smol_w8a8_down
items.rule: SmolLM-135M W8A8 layer 0, down_proj: A = SiLU(gate) * up (tokens 16-31, hidden 0-63) quantised per token (max abs over all 1536 / 127); B = the checkpoint's int8 down_proj rows 0-15 x hidden 0-63, transposed
items.open_case: R real model tiles: W8A8 projections and attention matmuls from two public W8A8 checkpoints (item 7; critic rank 8)

items.name: int8.real_smol_w8a8_q
items.rule: SmolLM-135M W8A8 layer 0, q_proj: A = input_layernorm output (tokens 16-31, dims 0-63) quantised per token (the token's max abs over all 576 dims / 127); B = the checkpoint's int8 q_proj rows 0-15 x dims 0-63, transposed
items.open_case: R real model tiles: W8A8 projections and attention matmuls from two public W8A8 checkpoints (item 7; critic rank 8)

items.name: int8.zeros
items.rule: every byte 0x00: every lane gated
